title: recap_meta
description: YouTube title, description and hashtags for a recap, written by scripts/recap_meta.py from the workspace edit.json and the deterministic facts the tool builds (brief text, the four facts place/when/who/occasion from brief_facts.json winning over the brief syntax and the ingest date, shot descriptions). The web app's Recap tab shows the fields with a Copy button each and marks the fact fields missing from the brief and brief_facts.json.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the file was written

tool.description: the script that wrote the file, e.g. scripts/recap_meta.py

title.description: the YouTube title, at most 100 characters

description.description: the YouTube description, 2-3 sentences, at most 1000 characters

missing.description: the fact fields the brief and brief_facts.json did not carry (place, when, who, occasion); the web app marks them

llm_cost_usd.description: USD the model calls of this run cost
